title: Perimeter, Area & Volume
description: Class 5 IMO — Perimeter, area and volume: perimeter of shapes, area of rectangle, square, triangle and parallelogram, volume of cube and cuboid, and word problems.

topics.title: Perimeter of Shapes
topics.concept:
The perimeter is the total distance around a shape — add the lengths of all the sides. For a triangle with sides 3, 4 and 5 cm, the perimeter is 3 + 4 + 5 = 12 cm.

For regular shapes there are shortcuts: square perimeter = 4 × side, and rectangle perimeter = 2 × (length + breadth).

examples.problem: Find the perimeter of a triangle with sides 3 cm, 4 cm and 5 cm.
Find the perimeter of a rectangle 8 cm by 3 cm.

quiz.q: What is the perimeter of a square of side 6 cm?
A four-sided shape has sides 2, 3, 4 and 5 cm. What is its perimeter?

topics.title: Area: Rectangle, Square, Triangle, Parallelogram
topics.concept: The area is the space inside a shape, in square units. Area of a rectangle = length × breadth, a square = side × side, a triangle = ½ × base × height, and a parallelogram = base × height.

examples.problem: Find the area of a triangle with base 6 cm and height 4 cm.
Find the area of a parallelogram with base 5 cm and height 4 cm.

recap: Rectangle: l × b; square: side × side.
Triangle: ½ × base × height; parallelogram: base × height.

quiz.q: What is the area of a triangle with base 10 cm and height 6 cm?
What is the area of a parallelogram with base 8 cm and height 3 cm?

topics.title: Volume of Cube & Cuboid
topics.concept:
The volume is the space a solid takes up, measured in cubic units. Volume of a cuboid = length × breadth × height, and volume of a cube = side × side × side.

So a 2 × 3 × 4 cuboid has volume 24 cubic units, and a cube of side 3 has volume 27 cubic units.

examples.problem: Find the volume of a cuboid 2 cm × 3 cm × 4 cm.
Find the volume of a cube of side 3 cm.

quiz.q: What is the volume of a cube of side 2 cm?
What is the volume of a cuboid 5 cm × 2 cm × 3 cm?

questions.q: Perimeter is to 'distance around' as volume is to ___ ?
questions.explanation: Volume is the space a solid takes up.

questions.q: Area of a triangle = ½ × base × ___ ?
questions.explanation: Area of a triangle = ½ × base × height.

questions.q: Which quantity is measured in cubic units?
questions.explanation: Volume is measured in cubic units.

questions.explanation: ½ × 8 × height = 24, so 4 × height = 24, height = 6 cm.
